name: Local file workflow
description: Import one configured local notes file and prepare cited task status previews for explicit user review. No model or outbound service is used.

setup.title: Check the notes file
setup.description: Read the configured file to verify bounded UTF-8 input without importing sources.

configuration.label: Notes file path
configuration.description: An absolute path to a UTF-8 notes file up to 64 KB. This trusted local executable reads exactly that configured file.

configuration.label: Imported title
configuration.description: Title of the canonical source imported by the connector.

configuration.label: Minimum exact citations
configuration.description: The evaluation contribution requires 1–20 distinct valid citations per case.

contributions.title: Import notes file
contributions.description: Read the configured file and submit one stable snapshot for host import.

contributions.title: Review action markers
contributions.description: Propose accepting current candidate tasks from explicitly selected sources. The host creates reviewable previews; this example returns proposals only.

contributions.title: Check evidence coverage
contributions.description: Check selected outputs in a saved project or personal eval run for a configured minimum of distinct exact evidence citations.
